name: 7Compare — should you actually buy it?
description: On any Indian store product page, see every other store's price and whether the discount is real. Free, no account.
//permissions: Deliberately minimal. There is no "tabs" permission, no "webNavigation",
no "<all_urls>" host access and no "declarativeNetRequest" — this
extension cannot see, rewrite or redirect your browsing anywhere except
the eleven store product pages listed below, and it only acts there when
"storage" holds two small things, both local to this browser and never
sent anywhere: the affiliate policy fetched from 7compare.7by.in, and a
session record that is a store name, a timestamp and a counter.

content_scripts.//: Our own site. Records which store a Buy click is heading to, so
content_scripts.//2: later navigation there can be recognised as the same referral.
Order matters. Content scripts in one list share a scope and run
content_scripts.//3: in order, so each file must come after everything it names:
content_scripts.//3a: shared/stores -> rank -> filters. Read by the engine and the
content_scripts.//3b: website too; they live here because the extension is the only
content_scripts.//3c: consumer that cannot import from outside its own folder.
content_scripts.//4: affiliate/config -> build -> eligible  (each uses the one before)
content_scripts.//4a: affiliate/links needs build; nothing needs affiliate/links
content_scripts.//6: stores/registry defines SEVEN; stores/adapters registers against
content_scripts.//7: it and reads the affiliate config and builder
content_scripts.//8: lib/affiliate wires eligible + build + log together
content_scripts.//9: content.js uses all of them, so it is last.
